_comment: Public suggestions/reading list fetched by the dashboard ONLY when a user opts in via the 'latest suggestions' checkbox (off by default). Served raw from this repo's main branch (SUGGEST_URL in web/index.html). No user data is ever sent — this is a one-way GET of a public file. Edit + push to main to update what opted-in users see; the bundled SUGGESTIONS list in web/index.html is the offline fallback. Each item: {title, blurb, url, tags}.
